content: {"episode_id":"ep-05004","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry) for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (G45.9, Z86.73). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management. This documentation supports the medical necessity of the service as requested in SilverBridge's letter."}
